LanguageData.FP_EnableFactionLimitTooltip: If enabled, new pawns will not be saved once the limit is reached. Returning veterans are always saved regardless of the limit.
LanguageData.FP_FactionVeteranLimitTooltip: Maximum number of veterans in the pool for each faction.\n\nSet to 0 to save ONLY characters you manually mark (with a star).
LanguageData.FP_ShowVIPButtonTooltip: Displays the 'Memory' button in the Social tab. Allows you to manually save any NPC to the veteran database (bypassing limits and filters) and write personal notes for specific pawns.
LanguageData.FP_VeteranRecallCooldownDaysTooltip: Cooldown period before a veteran can be summoned again.
LanguageData.FP_ForcedFreezeDaysTooltip: Number of rest days before 'hibernating' a pawn for optimization purposes.
LanguageData.FP_VeteranRecallChanceTooltip: Probability of using an existing veteran instead of generating a new pawn for world events.
LanguageData.FP_DeathDesc:
Annual probability of death for veterans over 60 years old:

• Archotech: 0.05%
• Ultratech: 0.5%
• Spacer: 1.5%
• Industrial: 2.5%
• Medieval: 5.0%
• Neolithic: 7.5%

This slider scales the chances listed above.
LanguageData.FP_RandomDeathDesc: Probability of a veteran dying each year from unknown circumstances (accidents, diseases, conflicts). This applies to pawns of ANY age.
LanguageData.FP_DiseaseDesc:
Annual probability of developing a chronic disease (60+ years):

• Archotech: 0.25%
• Ultratech: 0.5%
• Spacer: 2.5%
• Industrial: 5.0%
• Medieval: 7.5%
• Neolithic: 10.0%

This slider scales the chances listed above.
LanguageData.FP_ImplantDesc:
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Healing (All levels): If a veteran is missing a limb or eye, the faction will provide a prosthesis appropriate for their tech level (Tribal — wood, Empire — bionics).
2. Upgrade (Industrial+): 10% annual chance to replace a healthy body part with a more efficient implant.

This slider scales the overall probability of these events.
LanguageData.FP_GeneChanceTooltip: 10% chance for a normal gene (Spacer+), 5% for an Archite gene (Ultra+).
LanguageData.FP_AnomalyChanceTooltip: 5% chance for a Void contact event (Neolithic and Medieval tech levels).
LanguageData.FP_EnableDebugLogsTooltip: Output internal events to the dev console (~).
LanguageData.FP_ClearDatabaseConfirm: Are you absolutely sure you want to permanently delete all veterans from the database? This action is irreversible!
LanguageData.FP_AgingTooltip: Determines how many days a veteran ages per world aging cycle. Default is 60 days (1 year).
LanguageData.FP_ShowGizmoButton: Show Memory Button in Action Panel (Gizmo)
LanguageData.FP_ShowGizmoButtonTooltip: Display the 'Memory' button in the bottom action bar when a pawn is selected.
LanguageData.FP_AutoSaveWanderersTooltip: Automatically assign a permanent faction and save representatives of hidden or temporary factions (Ancients, refugees, beggars, etc.) when they leave the map.
LanguageData.FP_TechLevelRangeTooltip:
Determines which factions wanderers can join.

0 = Strict tech level match.
1 = Match or adjacent (e.g., Spacer can join Ultra or Industrial).
5 = Any level (Ancients can join tribals).
LanguageData.FP_OpenPawnMemoryPanelDesc: Open memory panel to manage this pawn's status and notes.
LanguageData.FP_StatusVeteran: Acquaintance\nI've met them before. They have their own path in the world, and who knows when we'll meet again.
LanguageData.FP_StatusPinned: I'll Remember You\nYou've marked this character. If they leave these lands alive, their story will continue.
LanguageData.FP_StatusDead: Rest in Peace\nThis person's story has ended. Their records will remain in our archives for one more aging year.
LanguageData.FP_StatusUnknown: Keep Watch\nIn this harsh world, it's easy to disappear without a trace. Mark them to ensure their journey is tracked.
LanguageData.FP_AlreadyInHistoryMsg: This character is already part of the world's history.
LanguageData.FP_EnableMothballTooltip: Allows the mod to 'put to sleep' inactive pawns to improve performance. Disable if using other aggressive optimization mods.
LanguageData.FP_EnableAgingVisualsTooltip: If enabled, humans and human-like creatures will gradually gray with biological age.
LanguageData.FP_StartGrayingRatioTooltip: Percentage of lifespan when hair starts turning gray. For humans (80 years), 45% is approximately 36 years.
LanguageData.FP_GrayingYearlyRatioTooltip: Determines how quickly hair turns gray. At 25%, a person will be fully gray by age 80. Higher values make the process slower.
LanguageData.FP_ShowMainTab: Show Veterans Tab in Bottom Bar
LanguageData.FP_ShowMainTabTooltip: Adds a 'Veterans' button to the bottom bar, allowing you to view all saved characters by faction.
LanguageData.FP_EnableFactionWipeCleanupTooltip: If enabled, veterans of a faction will be deleted if the faction has no settlements on the world map for a certain period of time.
LanguageData.FP_FactionWipeCleanupDaysTooltip: Number of days after losing the last settlement before the veterans of this faction are permanently removed from memory.
LanguageData.FP_Event_Aged: Years leave their mark: biological age reached {0}.
LanguageData.FP_Event_SkillUp: Mastery in {0} honed to a new level ({1}).
LanguageData.FP_Event_RegenScar: Scars of the past erased: {0} healed without a trace.
LanguageData.FP_Event_Gene: Nature itself shifted: new gene manifested — {0}.
LanguageData.FP_Event_Disease: The weight of years took its toll — developed {0}.
LanguageData.FP_Event_Anomaly: The Void touched this person, leaving a mark: {0}.
LanguageData.FP_Event_NaturalDeath: Died of old age at biological age {0}.
LanguageData.FP_Event_DiedOf: Life came to an end due to: {0}, at the age of {1}.
LanguageData.FP_Event_DiedInBattle: Fell on the battlefield at the age of {0}.
LanguageData.FP_Event_KilledByPawn: Fell at the hand of {1} ({0}), at the age of {2}.
LanguageData.FP_Event_KilledByDamage: Life was cut short by: {0}, at the age of {1}.
LanguageData.FP_EventsTooltip: View the life history and events of this person during their time in the world.
LanguageData.FP_EnableEventLoggingTooltip: If enabled, the mod will record key events in veterans' lives (aging, skills, implants). This slightly increases save file size.
LanguageData.FP_EventHistoryLimitTooltip: Determines how long to keep event records. Older records are automatically pruned annually.
